comments:
The same manuscript was printed twice in [Z5AUD7GQ], vol. 28 and [KUYBGM7V], vol. 74. In the latter, the folio numbers are visible and there are traces of the manuscript having been highlighted in color. The manuscript also appears in [JZ7IN6CW].

[8H6M69W4] reports 199 folios for No. 15875, which is the folio number on the last folio.
